extra.reason: Fixed in 3d0c508: from_json_bytes now runs the same simd-json parser as from_json_str/from_json_bytes_mut; the public serde Deserialize impl decodes the arbitrary_precision number token (const-parameter visitor mode, zero-cost on the simd path). Success-path + literal-magic-key + round-trip tests added. All gates green (conformance 1733/1733, clippy 121, fmt, wasm).

Fixed in 7dedd84: scan_regex consumes a backslash plus the full UTF-8 char it escapes as pattern text, so escaped brackets never move the depth counter (subsumes the old even/odd close-slash walk). docs/spec.md 2.5 updated, including a documented bidirectional deviation from jsonata-js on brackets preceded by an even number of backslashes (parity semantics chosen: /\\(x)/ lexes here, /\\}/ is S0302). 17 conformance cases + 6 lexer unit tests. Gates green (1750/1750, clippy 121).

Fixed in e6b387d: removed eval_chain's undefined short-circuit — every ~> stage now applies unconditionally, matching jsonata-js evaluateApplyExpression. Verified against a 45-expression jsonata-js matrix (all match post-fix; e.g. filter->count gives 0, substringAfter->exists gives false, undefined-propagating signatures still propagate). 13 conformance cases added, 9 of which fail on the old code. Gates green (1763/1763, clippy 121).

Fixed in daa49b5: mark_tail_position no longer sets thunk on a Function node carrying a group-by, so eval_group_by can never receive a TailCall sentinel. Note: reference jsonata-js is itself buggy here (drops the group, and leaks its own lambda sentinel for parenthesized callees), so the fix matches jsntrs's own non-tail semantics ({"k":{"v":1}}), which equal jsonata-js's non-tail semantics. 4 conformance cases + unit test. Gates green (1767/1767, clippy 121).

Fixed in 6129dab: collect_path_steps hoists a group-by found on any dot node in a flattened chain onto the resulting Path (S0210 if the chain carries more than one), matching jsonata-js processAST: a.b{G}.c behaves as (a.b.c){G}. Verified against jsonata-js on 10 expression/data variants (incl. arrays, chained groups, parenthesized forms). 9 conformance cases. Gates green (1776/1776, clippy 121).

Fixed in d85e80b: the array-constructor unwrap in fast_path::try_function is now restricted to //// via unwraps_array_constructor(kind), with the -deferral subtlety documented (([])=0 vs (undefined)=undefined is safe only because the Sum arm defers to the original AST on zero leaves). 32 differential divergences before, 0 after; 16 jsonata-js-verified expectations pinned in testdata. Gates green (1792/1792, clippy 121).

Fixed in dc6b434: fast_path::try_function now requires keep_array:false, group:None on the Function node, so $sum(prices)[] and $sum(prices){"k":$} fall through to the general path, mirroring collect_pure_path guards. 34 differential divergences before, 0 after; group-by shape pinned in testdata (jsonata-js-verified). The [] shape is deliberately NOT pinned in conformance: the general path itself diverges from jsonata-js there (filed as a follow-up). Gates green (1799/1799, clippy 121).

Fixed in 38c6905: extract_param_field now takes the Path node and mirrors fast_path::collect_pure_path (rejects keep_singleton_array on the Path and keep_array on the Name); three duplicate analyzer helpers collapsed into it so every lifted shape (FieldAccess, predicates, sort/reduce, concat templates, mapped-call args) shares one guarded predicate. 36 differential divergences before, 0 after; 9 jsonata-js-verified conformance cases. Gates green (1808/1808, clippy 121).

Fixed in 0dc1590: analyze_mapped_call declines the lift when the resolved callee is a Lambda declaring more params than the call supplies, deferring to the general paths (path steps prepend the context item, lambda-body calls pad with undefined — the arg template cannot distinguish them). Differential cases added (LAMBDA_ARITY fixtures); fail-before: 8 divergences. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in 869bc43: new is_mirrorable_literal gates the reversed literal-op-field normalization in analyze_binary and collect_predicate_clauses — only Number/String literals may move right (always pass compare left-operand type check); Eq/Ne stay unrestricted (symmetric). Fast path now matches general/jsonata-js T2010 on null/boolean vs missing field. +7 conformance cases (rust-hof-compare-literals), differential cases added; fail-before: 16 divergences. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in a46e487: MappedCall carries a check_signature flag (set when the general path would run eval_function: block-wrapped step or lambda-body call); exec_mapped_call replays process_call_args for SignedBuiltin callees before call_function. Deliberately NOT applied to bare function path steps whose general path (eval_path_function_step) performs no validation — unconditional checking would create the mirror divergence. +7 conformance cases (rust-hof-signature-lift), differential cases; fail-before: 16 divergences + 4 conformance failures. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in f06f595: new fast_path::eval_fast_with_bindings serves only binding-free fast-path classes (PurePath, Comparison) and the env-carrying entry points (evaluate_with_env, evaluate_with_custom_funcs, evaluate_with_vars, StreamEvaluator batch env) route through it; the Function class (26 FuncFastKind names) now takes the general path under caller bindings, honouring overrides. jsonata-js verified: binding shadows builtin (99), assign wins (77), non-function binding raises T1006 — all matched and pinned. Existing $round pin test kept (covers the dx5.13 prepared-state gate); new $sum tests cover each entry point. Measured cost confined to env-carrying func-fastpath expressions; follow-up filed for canonical-identity restoration. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in c44c5cc: the issue premise (keepArray never read on bare Function nodes) was WRONG — jsonata-js reads it generically but guards with isSequence(result). Plain deletion would have regressed flattening/case044 and function-match/case002. Implemented the real rule: call [] applies only when the result stands in for a sequence — stdlib::returns_sequence identity-matches the four builtins jsonata-js builds with createSequence but jsntrs collapses ($keys/$lookup/$filter/$match) via canonical Rc tables; Lambda => false so tail and non-tail agree. Same fix applied to the ~> chain step. Full verification matrix (bare/path-step/parens/lambda) matches reference; +24 conformance cases (rust-keep-array-call), 2 differential cases; fail-before: 13 conformance failures + 4 divergences. Gates green, clippy 121.

Resolved in 091c740 (tests only, jointly with jsntrs-e8l/c44c5cc): after e8l a lambda callee never honours [], so the direct path and the trampoline agree in every position — the tail/non-tail split ($id(5)[] vs tail $id($n)[]) is gone by construction. Pinned with +10 conformance cases (rust-keep-array-tailcall) and a position-independence unit test; fail-before evidence captured against the pre-e8l epilogue. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in HEAD (cherry-picked 24b83fc): eval_tuple_group now applies the reference key rule regardless of tuple mode — non-string non-undefined key raises T1003, undefined key skips the item, result starts as {} and is returned as-is (all-undefined group yields {} in both modes). Verified against jsonata-js source (evaluateGroupExpression) and a 35-expression matrix, 35/35 match post-fix. +15 conformance cases (rust-tuple-group-key); fail-before: 11 conformance failures with T1003. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in HEAD (cherry-picked 1c86579): $sift and $each now route callback dispatch through hof_args (args trimmed to callee declared arity; builtins get value only, matching the $map/$filter convention and jsonata-js getFunctionArity which uses implementation.length), and $each supplies the object as 3rd arg. hof_args takes a lazy second-arg closure so the key/index allocation stays off the arity-0/1 path — perf-neutral in a same-session A/B. docs/spec.md 5.5.8 corrected (Go-reference deviation labeled). +24 conformance cases (rust-hof-arity) + 2 unit tests; fail-before: 9 conformance failures. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in HEAD (cherry-picked dcfd382): extract_comments tracks a closed flag and no longer slices src[start..i] when a /* is never closed — format("/*\u{20AC}") now returns the lexer S0106 instead of panicking. Same change fixed an adjacent latent bug: regex literals containing escaped /* no longer emit a dangling comment. Byte-index audit recorded in the doc comment (ASCII delimiters cannot match UTF-8 continuation bytes). 5 unit tests added; new fuzz target fuzz_format (panic-freedom of format and format∘format) ran 1.27M execs clean; build verified on main post-pick. Fuzzer surfaced 4 pre-existing formatter round-trip bugs, documented in the target header — filing as follow-up beads. Gates green, clippy 121.

Fixed in HEAD (cherry-picked 98d1857): finiteness guard at $formatInteger entry raises D3001 "Number out of range" (same code/idiom as $string on Inf/NaN, per spec.md), stopping the float_to_words infinite loop; debug_assert added in float_to_words. Reachability wider than filed: 1/0 propagates Inf from plain JSON expressions, so the +6 conformance cases (rust-format-integer-nonfinite) pin it with pure fixtures; unit test crosses 13 pictures x Inf/-Inf/NaN = 39 D3001s. jsonata-js itself crashes (RangeError) or emits junk here, so a clean coded error is deliberately better than reference. Fail-before: hard hangs (exit 124/143) on w-pictures, "zero" for NaN. Gates green, clippy 121.

All three children fixed and closed: 5lw.1 (daa49b5, no thunk on grouped tail calls), 5lw.3 (6129dab, mid-path group hoist), 5lw.2 (091c740 with jsntrs-e8l/c44c5cc, call [] applies only to sequence results so tail and non-tail agree by construction). Thunk semantics decided: decorated nodes either are not thunked (group) or the decoration is a no-op for lambda results ([]).

Fixed in HEAD (cherry-picked ecc3b2d): FmtChars::from_opts parses exponent-separator; field widened to Option<char> (single char = Some, empty/multi-char = None so NO picture char is an exponent separator — mirrors jsonata-js char-vs-string matching where multi-char can never match, avoiding a value-vs-error divergence). Default e correctly becomes INACTIVE when a custom separator is set (D3086, matching reference). Unknown option keys stay ignored, matching jsonata-js — pinned. +15 conformance cases (rust-format-number-exponent), all expectations from reference; fail-before: 14/15 fail. Gates green, clippy 121. Reference bugs jsntrs does not share (prefix+exponent D3093, hang on negative/zero exponent pictures) documented in notes; one real jsntrs divergence (exponent separator treated as active in prefix/suffix scan) filed separately.

Done in HEAD (cherry-picked f07abb7): the differential harness now PROVES a lift fired — fast_path::testing gained a cfg-gated hit counter (zero-cost in release/wasm) bumped at the five sites the disable flag guards; assert_fast_matches_full asserts hits>0 and panics on bad fixtures; new assert_declined_matches_full asserts hits==0. CASES split into lift-required (250 pairs) and GENERAL_ONLY_CASES (180 pairs), enforced both directions — 144 vacuous pairs flushed and re-tiered, none deleted. New coverage: the 4 uncovered FuncFastKinds (Values/Reverse/Shuffle/Flatten), aggregate array-arg matrix completed, 19 missing kinds under []/{} postfix, 10 remaining reversed-literal combos + $sort/$reduce hosts, and an evaluate_with_env lane on every pair (empty custom env must never change an answer; override behavior owned by named unit tests, documented in header). Also fixed a real coverage bug: parenthesised $reduce accumulators never exercised ReduceCompoundAccum — unparenthesised twins added. Genuine divergence found and excluded (extends jsntrs-6wr.9, issue updated). Gates green, clippy 121, fuzz build ok.
